hero:
REINFORCEMENT LEARNING · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Try a move, see what happens, and improve the next decision

Instead of receiving a correct answer for every action, an agent learns from experiences and rewards over time.

questions.stem: Artificial Intelligenceలో Reinforcement Learning (RL) అంటే ఏమిటి? Agent Environmentలో Trial and Errorతో Actions Try చేసి Rewards, Penalties నుంచి Better Decisions ఎలా Learn చేస్తుంది?
questions.figure:
01 · Core idea

Learning from a wrong turn and a successful one

The agent tries actions and sees their results. Over many attempts, it learns which choices bring better rewards.
options: Agent Labeled Examples Memorize చేసి Environment Interaction లేకుండా Always Predict చేస్తుంది.
Fixed Hardcoded Path Follow చేసి Rewards Deployment తర్వాత మాత్రమే Collect చేస్తుంది.
Actions Try చేసి Outcomes Observe చేసి Reward Feedbackతో Decisions Improve చేస్తుంది.
Each Inputకి One Correct Action Guess చేసి Consequences Test చేయదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: RLలో Agent Actions Try చేసి Resultకి Reward పొందుతుంది. Repeated Practiceతో More Useful Decisions Learn చేయడానికి Try చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Agent State/Observation Receive చేసి Policyతో Action Choose చేస్తుంది. Environment Next State, Reward Return చేస్తుంది. Objective Long-Term Return Improve చేయడం; Trial-and-Errorకి Safety Constraints Important.

questions.stem: Reinforcement Learningలో Agent, Environment, State, Action, Reward, Policy Components ఎలా Work చేస్తాయి? Maze Navigate చేయడం నేర్చుకునే AI Exampleలో ఇవి ఎలా Understand చేయాలి?
questions.figure:
02 · Building blocks

A maze turns abstract RL terms into a repeatable loop

In the maze, the agent chooses a move, the world changes, and a reward arrives. Its policy guides future moves.
options: Agent Maze State Observe చేసి Policyతో Moves Choose చేసి Rewards నుంచి Learns చేస్తుంది.
Environment All Moves Choose చేస్తుంది; Agent Rewardsని Only Record చేస్తుంది.
Policy Maze Walls Describe చేస్తుంది; State After Episode Reward మాత్రమే Represent చేస్తుంది.
Action Current Location Describe చేస్తుంది; State Next Move Decide చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Mazeలో Agent Current Position చూస్తుంది, Move Choose చేస్తుంది, Reward పొందుతుంది. Policy అంటే Moves Decide చేసే Rule.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Maze Environment Walls, Rules Define చేస్తుంది. State Current Position, Action Up/Down/Left/Right, Reward Goal/Step Feedback. Policy π(a|s) Current Stateకి Which Action Choose చేయాలో Decide చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Rewards Delayedగా వచ్చినప్పుడు Agent ఏ Actions Useful అనేది ఎలా Learn చేస్తుంది? Unknown Actions Explore చేయడం, Known Good Actions Exploit చేయడం మధ్య Balance ఎందుకు Important?
questions.figure:
03 · Credit over time

Trying an unfamiliar route may pay off later

Exploration tries uncertain moves; exploitation uses known ones. A reward arriving later can make an earlier action worthwhile.
options: One Stepలో Highest Reward ఇచ్చిన Actionని Always Select చేయడమే Best.
Delayed Rewards ఉన్నప్పుడు Trainingలో All Unfamiliar Actions Avoid చేయాలి.
Exploration Successful Move Repeat చేస్తుంది; Exploitation Random New Moves Try చేస్తుంది.
Exploration Alternatives Try చేస్తుంది; Exploitation Known Choices Use; Future Rewards Evaluate చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: కొన్ని Actions Reward Later ఇస్తాయి. Exploration New Choices Test చేస్తుంది; Exploitation ఇప్పటికే Promising Choicesని Use చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Delayed Reward Problemలో Early Moves Later Successని Affect చేయవచ్చు. Exploration Unknown Actions Try చేసి Knowledge Gain చేస్తుంది; Exploitation Current Best Options Use చేస్తుంది. Too Much Either Side Learningకి Limit కావచ్చు.

questions.stem: Markov Decision Process (MDP)తో RLని Mathematically ఎలా Model చేస్తాం? States, Actions, Transition Probabilities, Reward Functions, Discount Factor, Policy, Value Functions, Bellman Equation Role ఏమిటి?
questions.figure:
04 · MDP mathematics

The Bellman equation connects now with what comes next

An MDP tracks possible next states and rewards. The Bellman equation combines immediate reward with discounted future value.
options: MDP Actions Only Store చేస్తుంది; Bellman Equations Future Rewardsని Ignore చేస్తాయి.
MDP Transitions, Rewards Model చేస్తుంది; Bellman Present Valueని Future Returnsతో Connect చేస్తుంది.
Discount Factor Action Count Determine చేస్తుంది; Value Function Only Action Frequency Measure చేస్తుంది.
Policy All Transition Probabilities Fix చేస్తుంది; Reward Function Every Future State Define చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: MDP Possible States, Moves, Rewardsని Describe చేస్తుంది. Bellman Equation Present Rewardతో Expected Future Rewardsని Connect చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. MDPలో States S, Actions A, Transition P(s'|s,a), Reward R, Discount γ, Policy π ఉంటాయి. Bellman Relation Vπ(s)=E[r+γVπ(s')|s]గా Current Value, Future Return Link చేస్తుంది. Discount Future Rewards Weight Control చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Python, Gymnasiumలో RL Agent ఎలా Build, Train చేస్తాం? Environment Create, States, Actions Define, Q-Learning Q-Table Update, Exploration Rate Adjust, Learned Policy Evaluate ఎలా చేస్తాం?
questions.figure:
05 · Python & Gymnasium

Q-learning improves action scores while exploration fades

Inside the learning loopQ[s,a] += α * (r + γ * best_next - Q[s,a])Evaluate afterward with exploration turned off.

Q-values estimate how useful actions may be. As practice grows, the agent tests fewer random moves and relies more on learning.
options: Gymnasiumలో Q-Learning State-Action Scores Update చేసి Learned Greedy Policy Evaluate చేస్తాం.
Q-Learning Rewards Collect చేయకముందే Every Stateని Neural Networkతో Replace చేస్తుంది.
Q-Learning Actions Track చేయకుండా Each Stateలో Rewards Only Average చేస్తుంది.
Training Success Guarantee చేయడానికి Gymnasium Reward Rulesని Evaluationలో Rewrite చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Q-Learning ప్రతి Stateలో Each Actionకి Score Store చేస్తుంది. Practiceతో Scores Update చేసి Testingలో Better Path Search చేస్తాం.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Gymnasium env.reset(), env.step(action) Interfacesతో Q-Table Maintain చేస్తాం. Q(s,a) ← Q(s,a)+α[r+γmax Q(s',a')−Q(s,a)]. Epsilon-Greedy Exploration Reduce చేసి Separate Evaluationలో Success Rate Check చేస్తాం.

questions.stem: DQN, Policy Gradient, Actor-Critic, PPO, SAC Algorithms ఎలా Differ అవుతాయి? Value-Based, Policy-Based, Model-Based, Model-Free Methods Complex Environments, Continuous Actions ఎలా Handle చేస్తాయి?
questions.figure:
06 · Algorithm families

Different methods learn values, policies, or both

DQN learns action scores. Policy methods choose actions directly. Actor–critic combines both; PPO and SAC improve that approach in different ways.
options: DQN Direct Continuous Actions Learn చేస్తుంది; SAC Only Discrete Choices Handle చేస్తుంది.
PPO Complete Transition Model Build చేస్తుంది; Policy Gradients Simple Fixed Q-Table Only Use చేస్తాయి.
DQN Action Values Learns; PPO Updates Limit; SAC Continuous Controlలో Entropy Use చేస్తుంది.
Actor-Critic Reward Table Only Use చేస్తుంది; Model-Based Methods Transitions Predict చేయవు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: DQN Action Values Estimate చేస్తుంది; Policy Methods Actions Directగా Learn చేస్తాయి. PPO, SAC Different Waysలో Training Stability Manage చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. DQN Discrete Actionsకి Q-Network, Replay/Target Networks Use చేస్తుంది. Policy Gradient Action Distribution Optimize చేస్తుంది; Actor-Critic Policy+Value Combine. PPO Restricted Policy Updates, SAC Entropy-Regularized Continuous Control Use చేస్తాయి. Model-Based Approaches Environment Dynamics Predict చేస్తాయి.

questions.figure:
07 · Deployment risks

A high score can hide an unsafe or useless strategy

An agent may game its reward or behave differently outside simulation. Better feedback, demonstrations, and safety checks reduce risk.
options: Exploration Remove చేస్తే Sparse Rewards Solve అవుతాయి; Early Stoppingతో Safety Guaranteed.
Reward Shaping, Imitation Help చేస్తాయి; Constraints, Offline Evaluation Risks Reduce చేస్తాయి.
Bigger Modelsతో Reward Hacking Disappear అవుతుంది; Simulation Real-World Success Guarantee చేస్తుంది.
Offline Data Online Testingని Replace చేస్తుంది; Gradient Clipping Every Issue Fix చేస్తుంది.
